content.text: {"headline":"Approve R2 (earlier overtime, chat deflection, break and coaching tweaks) for ₹15,579, and involve the duty manager: it lifts service level to about 59% for 11:15-15:30 but still falls short of the 80% target.","why":"The surge is real customer demand from SMS campaign MKT-2026-825, sent at 10:15 to 700,000 people. Calls were 143 vs 85.3 forecast at 11:00 (+68%), driven mainly by loan enquiries at 2.02x normal. Service level has already dropped to 41.3%. Doing nothing predicts 32.8% (general queue 17.4%) and 19.4% abandons. R2 puts overtime into the worst hours: 34 general agents 11:45-13:45 and 30 more 13:45-14:45. It also deflects 20% of balance enquiries to chat, delays the 11:15-11:45 breaks by 45 minutes, lends 2 payments agents to general 15:00-16:00 and cancels general coaching 15:30-16:00. The prediction for 11:15-15:30 is 59.1% overall (payments 63.2%, general 55.4%), with 9.7% abandons and 72.3% for the rest of the day. It is the cheapest compliant plan among those that perform best. Escalation is flagged under ESC-02 because even this best compliant plan is predicted below the 70% line, so the duty manager should be involved.","trade_offs":["R1 gives almost the same result (59.0%) but costs ₹16,029, which is ₹450 more than R2.","P3 predicts the highest service level (67.3%, 7.1% abandons) but depends on a known-issue IVR message. Policy CX-01 does not allow that message here because there is no confirmed outage, so it is not compliant.","P4 is compliant and cheaper at ₹13,680 but reaches only 53.4%, with the general queue at 44.1%.","The no-cost or low-cost options (P0 and P1 at ₹225, plus P2, which also breaks CX-01) stay around 32-34% and do not touch the problem.","Payments is not hurt by R2: it is predicted at 63.2% vs 50.4% with no action, because the 2 agents are only moved after 15:00."],"watch":"Watch general-queue service level and abandons once overtime starts at 11:45, and check that enough of the 34 overtime offers are accepted. With the duty manager, decide whether to ask marketing to pause or reword the campaign, and how to handle the target shortfall."}
